data.label: Get More Calls
data.title:
5 website changes that
*bring more bookings*
data.sub: Swipe to see if your site is ready →

data.label: Tip #1
data.title: Put your *phone number* on top
data.body: Customers are often in a hurry. If they have to hunt for your number, they will leave your site and call a competitor instead.
data.fix: Fix: Add your phone number to the very top header.

data.label: Tip #2
data.title: Add a *booking button* clearly
data.body: Don't make clients email you to ask about availability. A clear button lets them secure a spot instantly while they are interested.
data.fix: Fix: Place a 'Book Now' button in your main menu.

data.label: Tip #3
data.title: Show *customer reviews* upfront
data.body: New clients want to know you are trustworthy. Seeing a few nice words from others removes the fear of hiring a stranger.
data.fix: Fix: Add three recent reviews to your home page.

data.label: Tip #4
data.title: Check your *mobile view*
data.body: Most of your customers are searching on their phones while on the go. If your site looks messy, they will click away immediately.
data.fix: Fix: Open your site on your phone and check readability.

data.label: Tip #5
data.title: List your *service areas*
data.body: People need to know if you travel to them right away. Clearly listing your locations saves time for both you and your clients.
data.fix: Fix: Add a list of cities you serve to the footer.
